correctness.rationale: Exact forest/path-forest bijection with preserved size and component count; labeled alternating-path enumeration includes the endpoint orientation and reversal factors, isolates and exponential normalization. value.rationale: The new evaluated two-parameter, size-and-component polynomial classifies all induced forests of a natural Cartesian-product graph family; it simultaneously gives all feedback vertex set counts and the exact multiplicity/component spectrum of every minimum feedback vertex set. A sharp rectangular aspect-ratio transition, and exact small examples, distinguish configurations not visible from prior max-size bounds or the general line-graph equivalence. The objects and refinements have direct graph-theoretic motivation; this is not an arbitrary small-graph slice.
